description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the performance ratio of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), ChatGPT (yellow), and a third model represented by red bars—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, presented in left-to-right order as "Movies," "Songs," and "Basketball." The vertical axis, labeled "Ratio (%)," is scaled linearly from 50 to 90, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10 percentage points. For each domain, three grouped bars are displayed side-by-side, corresponding to the three models as indicated by the legend. In the "Movies" category, the blue bar (Llama3) reaches a value of approximately 90%, the red bar (the third model) also reaches approximately 90%, and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) reaches approximately 72%. In the "Songs" category, the blue bar (Llama3) is approximately 84%, the red bar (the third model) is approximately 90%, and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) is approximately 62%. In the "Basketball" category, the blue bar (Llama3) is approximately 67%, the red bar (the third model) is approximately 58%, and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) is approximately 61%. The bars are not sorted by value; instead, they are presented in the order of the categories on the horizontal axis. There is no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar beyond their color-coding and grouping.
